goals.title: Speak English clearly and confidently in daily life
goals.description: Build real-world spoken fluency for daily life, professional situations, calls, meetings, hotels, directions, opinions, family events, group settings, and conversations with unfamiliar people through 180 days of connected listening, reading, writing, and speaking practice

projects.name: 180-Day English Speaking Plan
projects.description: Six month daily practice program using Listening then Reading then Writing then Speaking chain, progressing from self introduction to full professional and social fluency

habits.title: English practice session: Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking

tasks.title: Day 1 Self introduction basics
tasks.description: Listen to a 15 minute day in my life vlog, read a short intro bio, write 4 to 5 sentences introducing yourself, speak recording a 2 minute free talk about yourself with no script

tasks.title: Day 2 Morning routine
tasks.description: Listen to same vlog again noticing 5 useful phrases, read a morning routine article, write 4 to 5 sentences describing your morning routine, speak describing your routine out loud as if doing it now

tasks.title: Day 3 Job or studies
tasks.description: Listen to a different vlogger talking about their job or studies, read a short career description text, write 4 to 5 sentences describing your job or studies, speak explaining them in your own words for 2 minutes

tasks.title: Day 4 Tell me about yourself
tasks.description: Listen to a short interview clip on tell me about yourself, read a sample Q and A transcript, write your own 5 sentence answer, speak answering that question out loud 3 different ways

tasks.title: Day 5 Describe hometown
tasks.description: Listen to a podcast intro segment, read a short city guide paragraph, write 4 to 5 sentences describing your hometown, speak describing your hometown to an imaginary stranger for 2 minutes

tasks.title: Day 6 Hobbies
tasks.description: Listen to a casual conversation about hobbies, read a short article about a hobby, write 4 to 5 sentences about your hobbies and why you enjoy them, speak talking about your hobbies for 2 minutes unscripted

tasks.title: Day 7 Review who am I
tasks.description: Read your own writing from days 1 to 6, write one paragraph on who am I, speak free talking for 5 minutes on who am I and record

tasks.title: Day 8 Morning routine narration
tasks.description: Listen to a morning routine video, read a short healthy habits article, write your actual daily routine step by step, speak narrating your morning routine live as if doing it now

tasks.title: Day 9 Typical week
tasks.description: Listen to someone describing their week, read a short weekly planner blog post, write your typical week day by day, speak describing your typical week out loud for 2 minutes

tasks.title: Day 10 Food and meals
tasks.description: Listen to a food vlog, read a short food diary or recipe snippet, write what you ate today and why, speak describing today's meals out loud naturally

tasks.title: Day 11 Health habits
tasks.description: Listen to someone talking about exercise and health, read a short fitness article, write 4 to 5 sentences about your health habits, speak talking about them for 2 minutes

tasks.title: Day 12 Last weekend
tasks.description: Listen to someone describing their weekend, read a short weekend plans post, write about your last weekend, speak describing it out loud for 2 minutes

tasks.title: Day 13 Sleep habits
tasks.description: Listen to a short clip about sleep and rest habits, read a short sleep health article, write 4 to 5 sentences about your sleep habits, speak talking about them and how you feel about them

tasks.title: Day 14 Review typical day
tasks.description: Read your week 2 writing, write one paragraph on my typical day, speak free talking for 5 minutes record then listen back once

tasks.title: Day 15 Opinion on weather news
tasks.description: Listen to two people mildly disagreeing, read a short weather news snippet, write your opinion on today's weather or news, speak giving your opinion for 2 minutes

tasks.title: Day 16 Product review
tasks.description: Listen to a product review video, read a short written product review, write a mini review of something you own, speak reviewing that item as if talking to a friend

tasks.title: Day 17 Movie opinion
tasks.description: Listen to someone explaining why they like a movie, read a short movie review, write 4 to 5 sentences on why you liked a movie or show, speak talking about it for 2 minutes

tasks.title: Day 18 Dislike opinion
tasks.description: Listen to someone explaining why they dislike something, read a short negative review or complaint post, write about something you dislike and why, speak talking about it for 2 minutes explaining your reasons

tasks.title: Day 19 Food opinion
tasks.description: Listen to a short opinion clip on food, read a short restaurant review, write your opinion on a restaurant or dish, speak giving your food opinion naturally

tasks.title: Day 20 Comparing two things
tasks.description: Listen to someone comparing two things, read a short comparison article, write a comparison of two things you know well, speak comparing them for 2 minutes

tasks.title: Day 21 Review opinion on city
tasks.description: Read your week 3 writing, write one paragraph on my opinion of my city, speak free talking for 3 minutes and record

tasks.title: Day 22 Confident speaking energy
tasks.description: Listen to a confident TED talk intro, read the transcript or a summary of the topic, write your own take on the topic, speak on that topic with the same energy in your own words

tasks.title: Day 23 Personal story
tasks.description: Listen to someone telling a short personal story, read a short personal essay excerpt, write a short story from your own life, speak telling that story out loud

tasks.title: Day 24 A mistake I made
tasks.description: Listen to someone describing a mistake they made, read a short lessons learned post, write about a mistake you made and what happened, speak telling that story out loud naturally

tasks.title: Day 25 Giving advice
tasks.description: Listen to someone giving advice, read a short advice column, write advice for an imaginary friend with a problem, speak giving that advice as if speaking to them

tasks.title: Day 26 How's life response
tasks.description: Listen to a casual chat between friends, read a short text message exchange, write how you would respond if a friend asked how is life, speak answering that question naturally several ways

tasks.title: Day 27 Summarize content
tasks.description: Listen to any 15 minute content of your choice, read a short summary on the same topic, write a 4 to 5 sentence summary of what you heard, speak summarizing it out loud in your own words

tasks.title: Day 28 Month 1 review
tasks.description: Read all your month 1 writing, write one paragraph on what I have learned about myself this month, speak free talking for 5 minutes record and compare to day 1 recording

tasks.title: Day 29 Asking directions
tasks.description: Listen to a conversation about asking and giving directions, read a short travel directions text, write sentences explaining how to reach a place you know, speak role playing asking for and giving directions

tasks.title: Day 30 Giving directions
tasks.description: Listen to someone giving directions in detail, read a short how to get to X text, write directions from your house to the nearest landmark, speak giving those directions to a stranger

tasks.title: Day 31 Airport station questions
tasks.description: Listen to airport or bus station announcements, read a short signage or FAQ text, write 3 questions about platforms or gates, speak role playing asking where the platform or gate is

tasks.title: Day 32 Taxi rideshare conversation
tasks.description: Listen to a taxi or rideshare conversation, read a short rideshare FAQ or review, write a short dialogue with the driver, speak role playing that conversation out loud

tasks.title: Day 33 Lost tourist phrases
tasks.description: Listen to someone lost in a city asking locals, read a short lost tourist travel blog story, write 3 different ways to say I am looking for, speak practicing all 3 with different phrasing

tasks.title: Day 34 Describing a route
tasks.description: Listen to GPS or map app voice instructions, read a short route description text, write a route description from memory, speak describing that route to an imaginary listener

tasks.title: Day 35 Review directions to favorite place
tasks.description: Read your week 5 writing, write directions to your favorite place in town, speak free talking giving those directions then talking about why you like that place

tasks.title: Day 36 Buying clothes
tasks.description: Listen to a shopping conversation buying clothes, read a short clothing store or size guide text, write a short dialogue about size price and trying on, speak role playing buying clothes

tasks.title: Day 37 Bargaining at market
tasks.description: Listen to a bargaining market scene, read a short article on bargaining etiquette, write 3 phrases for negotiating a price, speak practicing negotiating a price out loud

tasks.title: Day 38 Returning an item
tasks.description: Listen to a conversation about returning an item, read a short store return policy text, write a short explanation of why you are returning a faulty product, speak role playing returning that item

tasks.title: Day 39 Paying at counter
tasks.description: Listen to a paying at the counter clip, read a short receipt or payment FAQ, write a short cashier small talk exchange, speak practicing that small talk out loud

tasks.title: Day 40 Missing delivery call
tasks.description: Listen to a call about a missing delivery, read a short delivery complaint email, write what you would say on the call, speak role playing that phone call out loud

tasks.title: Day 41 Grocery shopping
tasks.description: Listen to a grocery store conversation, read a short grocery list or meal planning text, write what is in your fridge and what you need to buy, speak describing that out loud naturally

tasks.title: Day 42 Review shopping trip
tasks.description: Read your week 6 writing, write a paragraph about your last shopping trip, speak free talking about that shopping trip for 3 minutes

tasks.title: Day 43 Ordering food
tasks.description: Listen to a restaurant ordering scene, read a short menu with descriptions, write questions about ingredients and your order, speak role playing ordering food and asking questions

tasks.title: Day 44 Restaurant complaint
tasks.description: Listen to a waiter and customer complaint clip, read a short complaint letter example, write a polite complaint about a wrong order, speak role playing that complaint out loud

tasks.title: Day 45 Cafe small talk
tasks.description: Listen to cafe small talk, read a short cafe menu or blog post, write a short coffee order and small talk dialogue, speak role playing ordering coffee with small talk

tasks.title: Day 46 Explaining a recipe
tasks.description: Listen to someone describing a recipe, read a short recipe text, write the steps to cook your favorite dish, speak explaining how to cook it as if teaching someone

tasks.title: Day 47 Food allergy explanation
tasks.description: Listen to a food allergy conversation, read a short allergy or dietary restriction note, write how you would explain a dietary restriction to a waiter, speak role playing explaining that restriction

tasks.title: Day 48 Dinner table small talk
tasks.description: Listen to a dinner table conversation clip, read a short article on dinner party etiquette, write 3 small talk topics for dinner with new people, speak imagining and speaking that dinner small talk

tasks.title: Day 49 Review best meal story
tasks.description: Read your week 7 writing, write a short story on the best meal I have ever had, speak telling that story out loud for 3 minutes

tasks.title: Day 50 Bus train small talk
tasks.description: Listen to bus or train small talk, read a short public transport announcement text, write a short small talk exchange with a stranger on a bus, speak role playing that small talk out loud

tasks.title: Day 51 Weather and plans
tasks.description: Listen to a weather report and reactions, read a short weather forecast text, write about today's weather and your plans around it, speak talking about the weather and plans naturally

tasks.title: Day 52 Small talk openers
tasks.description: Listen to elevator or waiting room small talk, read a short article on small talk openers, write 3 different small talk openers, speak practicing all 3 with a natural tone

tasks.title: Day 53 Traffic complaint
tasks.description: Listen to someone complaining about traffic, read a short commuter complaint forum post, write about your commute and a complaint about it, speak describing your commute and complaining naturally

tasks.title: Day 54 How are you responses
tasks.description: Listen to casual how is it going exchanges, read a short list of casual greeting responses, write 5 different responses to how are you, speak practicing all 5 with different tones

tasks.title: Day 55 Street interview questions
tasks.description: Listen to a street interview video, read a short article on the topic, write answers to 3 random street interview style questions, speak answering those 3 questions unscripted

tasks.title: Day 56 Month 2 review
tasks.description: Read all your month 2 writing, write a paragraph on a normal day running errands in my city, speak free talking for 5 minutes record and compare to week 5 day 1

tasks.title: Day 57 Family members
tasks.description: Listen to a family dinner scene, read a short family blog post, write 4 to 5 sentences about each of your family members, speak talking about your family one by one

tasks.title: Day 58 Relationship with parents
tasks.description: Listen to someone talking about their parents, read a short article on parent child relationships, write about your relationship with your parents, speak describing that relationship naturally

tasks.title: Day 59 Sibling memory
tasks.description: Listen to a sibling conversation clip, read a short sibling memory blog post, write a memory with a sibling or cousin, speak telling that story out loud

tasks.title: Day 60 Family gathering
tasks.description: Listen to a family celebration video, read a short article about family gatherings and traditions, write about your last family gathering, speak describing that gathering for 2 minutes

tasks.title: Day 61 Sharing family news
tasks.description: Listen to someone giving family news, read a short life update message example, write how you would tell family about a life update, speak practicing telling that news out loud

tasks.title: Day 62 Story from older relative
tasks.description: Listen to a grandparents stories clip, read a short oral history excerpt, write a story you heard from an older relative, speak telling that story out loud

tasks.title: Day 63 Review my family
tasks.description: Read your week 9 writing, write a my family summary paragraph, speak free talking about my family for 3 minutes

tasks.title: Day 64 Planning a hangout
tasks.description: Listen to friends planning a hangout, read a short group chat planning example, write a message planning to meet a friend this weekend, speak role playing that planning conversation

tasks.title: Day 65 Long time no see
tasks.description: Listen to friends catching up after a while, read a short long time no see dialogue example, write a short catch up conversation, speak role playing that conversation out loud

tasks.title: Day 66 Joking with friends
tasks.description: Listen to a friend group joking around, read a short article on humor and banter styles, write 3 light friendly jokes or teasing lines, speak practicing a light teasing tone out loud

tasks.title: Day 67 Relationship advice
tasks.description: Listen to a friend giving relationship advice, read a short advice column excerpt, write advice for an imaginary friend's relationship problem, speak giving that advice out loud

tasks.title: Day 68 Suggesting a trip
tasks.description: Listen to a group trip planning clip, read a short travel planning blog post, write a trip idea to suggest to friends, speak suggesting that trip persuasively

tasks.title: Day 69 Disagreeing politely
tasks.description: Listen to friends disagreeing on plans, read a short article on polite disagreement phrases, write 3 polite ways to disagree with a friend's suggestion, speak practicing disagreeing politely

tasks.title: Day 70 Review closest friend
tasks.description: Read your week 10 writing, write a paragraph on my closest friend, speak free talking describing that friend and why they matter

tasks.title: Day 71 Jumping into conversation
tasks.description: Listen to a group discussion podcast, read a short article on joining conversations, write 3 phrases for jumping into a conversation, speak practicing jumping in out loud

tasks.title: Day 72 Polite interruptions
tasks.description: Listen to someone interrupting politely, read a short etiquette article on interruptions, write 3 polite interruption phrases, speak practicing all 3 in context

tasks.title: Day 73 Group brainstorming
tasks.description: Listen to a group brainstorming clip, read a short brainstorming or meeting notes example, write one idea to contribute to a discussion, speak presenting that idea to an imaginary group

tasks.title: Day 74 Group introductions
tasks.description: Listen to party or event small talk, read a short networking or party etiquette article, write a self introduction for a group setting, speak practicing introducing yourself to a group

tasks.title: Day 75 Stating and defending opinion
tasks.description: Listen to a group debate clip, read a short opinion article on a debated topic, write your opinion and one reason to support it, speak stating and defending that opinion in 1 minute

tasks.title: Day 76 Smooth topic transitions
tasks.description: Listen to someone changing topics smoothly, read a short article on conversation transitions, write a transition sentence between two topics, speak practicing transitioning naturally

tasks.title: Day 77 Review group discussion response
tasks.description: Read a current news headline, write your opinion on that headline, speak free talking on what would I say in a group discussion today

tasks.title: Day 78 Toast or celebration speech
tasks.description: Listen to a wedding or celebration speech clip, read a short sample toast or speech text, write a short toast or congratulations speech, speak practicing that speech out loud

tasks.title: Day 79 Comforting someone
tasks.description: Listen to a condolence conversation, read a short article on comforting language, write comforting words for a friend going through a hard time, speak practicing comforting someone respectfully

tasks.title: Day 80 Reacting to good news
tasks.description: Listen to someone sharing exciting news, read a short good news message example, write a reaction to imaginary good news, speak reacting to that news enthusiastically

tasks.title: Day 81 Sincere apology
tasks.description: Listen to someone apologizing, read a short article on sincere apologies, write a sincere apology for a real or imagined situation, speak practicing that apology out loud

tasks.title: Day 82 Birthday party mingling
tasks.description: Listen to birthday party small talk, read a short party invitation or small talk text, write 3 small talk lines for a birthday party, speak role playing mingling at a birthday party

tasks.title: Day 83 Expressing gratitude
tasks.description: Listen to someone expressing gratitude, read a short thank you note example, write a meaningful thank you message, speak practicing thanking someone meaningfully

tasks.title: Day 84 Month 3 review
tasks.description: Read all your month 3 writing, write on the most important people in my life, speak free talking for 5 minutes record and compare tone to week 9

tasks.title: Day 85 Hotel check-in
tasks.description: Listen to a hotel check-in conversation, read a short hotel booking confirmation text, write a check-in dialogue with name reservation and requests, speak role playing checking into a hotel

tasks.title: Day 86 Room service call
tasks.description: Listen to a room service call clip, read a short room service menu, write what you would order and ask on the call, speak role playing calling room service

tasks.title: Day 87 Hotel room complaint
tasks.description: Listen to a complaint about a hotel room, read a short hotel complaint review, write a polite complaint about a room issue, speak practicing that complaint out loud

tasks.title: Day 88 Asking staff for recommendations
tasks.description: Listen to asking hotel staff for recommendations, read a short things to do nearby guide, write questions asking staff for recommendations, speak role playing asking staff for recommendations

tasks.title: Day 89 Hotel checkout
tasks.description: Listen to a checkout conversation, read a short hotel bill or invoice example, write questions about your bill at checkout, speak role playing checking out and asking about the bill

tasks.title: Day 90 Phone hotel booking
tasks.description: Listen to booking a hotel by phone, read a short hotel website booking page text, write a phone booking script with dates room type and price, speak role playing a phone booking call and record a 3 minute free talk checkpoint

tasks.title: Day 91 Review ideal hotel stay
tasks.description: Read your week 13 writing, write on my ideal hotel stay, speak free talking about that ideal stay for 3 minutes

tasks.title: Day 92 Airport check-in
tasks.description: Listen to an airport check-in clip, read a short airline check-in FAQ, write a check-in dialogue with passport baggage and seat, speak role playing checking in for a flight

tasks.title: Day 93 Security customs questions
tasks.description: Listen to a security or customs conversation, read a short customs declaration text, write answers to typical customs questions, speak role playing answering customs questions

tasks.title: Day 94 Flight delay reactions
tasks.description: Listen to a flight delay announcement and reactions, read a short flight status or delay notice, write questions to ask staff about a delayed flight, speak reacting to and asking about a delayed flight

tasks.title: Day 95 Asking for help with luggage
tasks.description: Listen to asking for help with luggage, read a short airport services text, write a request for help with luggage, speak role playing asking for help at an airport

tasks.title: Day 96 Asking locals for recommendations
tasks.description: Listen to a tourist asking locals for recommendations, read a short best places to visit guide, write 3 questions to ask a local, speak asking an imaginary local for the best places to visit

tasks.title: Day 97 Telling a travel story
tasks.description: Listen to a travel story video, read a short travel blog story, write a short travel story real or imagined, speak telling that travel story out loud

tasks.title: Day 98 Review dream trip
tasks.description: Read your week 14 writing, write a my dream trip plan, speak free talking and planning that dream trip out loud

tasks.title: Day 99 Starting conversation with stranger
tasks.description: Listen to stranger small talk in a park or cafe, read a short article on starting conversations with strangers, write 3 conversation starter lines, speak practicing starting a conversation with a stranger

tasks.title: Day 100 Asking a stranger for a favor
tasks.description: Listen to someone asking a stranger for a favor, read a short polite requests article, write a polite request such as a photo or help with bags, speak role playing asking a stranger for that favor

tasks.title: Day 101 Networking self introduction
tasks.description: Listen to networking event small talk, read a short networking tips article, write a self introduction for an event, speak practicing introducing yourself at an event

tasks.title: Day 102 Exchanging contacts
tasks.description: Listen to someone making a new friend, read a short how to exchange contacts tips text, write a natural way to ask for someone's contact info, speak practicing exchanging contact info naturally

tasks.title: Day 103 Restarting stalled conversation
tasks.description: Listen to an awkward silence recovery clip, read a short article on restarting stalled conversations, write 2 lines to restart a stalled conversation, speak practicing restarting a stalled conversation

tasks.title: Day 104 Adapting small talk
tasks.description: Listen to a video on cultural small talk differences, read a short cross cultural communication article, write how you would adapt your small talk to a new person, speak practicing adapting your small talk out loud

tasks.title: Day 105 Review talking to someone new
tasks.description: Read your week 15 writing, write on talking to someone I have never met, speak free talking on what would I say first to a stranger

tasks.title: Day 106 Customer service call
tasks.description: Listen to a customer service call clip, read a short customer service complaint email, write what you would say calling about a problem, speak role playing that customer service call

tasks.title: Day 107 Booking appointment by phone
tasks.description: Listen to booking an appointment by phone, read a short clinic or appointment booking text, write a script for calling to book a doctor's appointment, speak role playing that phone call

tasks.title: Day 108 Clarifying on bad connection
tasks.description: Listen to a phone call with bad connection, read a short article on clarifying phrases, write 3 ways to say sorry can you repeat that, speak practicing all 3 naturally

tasks.title: Day 109 Leaving a voicemail
tasks.description: Listen to a voicemail message example, read a short voicemail script example, write a voicemail message for an imaginary contact, speak leaving that practice voicemail and record it

tasks.title: Day 110 Starting a video call
tasks.description: Listen to video call small talk, read a short remote meeting etiquette article, write an opening line for a video call, speak practicing starting a video call out loud

tasks.title: Day 111 Answering unexpected calls
tasks.description: Listen to a cold call or unknown number conversation, read a short article on handling unexpected calls, write how you would politely answer, speak role playing answering that call politely

tasks.title: Day 112 Month 4 review
tasks.description: Read all your month 4 writing, write on a day where I only spoke to strangers, speak free talking for 5 minutes record and compare to month 1 recordings

tasks.title: Day 113 Office small talk
tasks.description: Listen to an office small talk clip, read a short workplace culture article, write 3 Monday morning small talk lines, speak practicing office small talk out loud

tasks.title: Day 114 Professional self introduction
tasks.description: Listen to someone introducing themselves professionally, read a short professional bio or LinkedIn style text, write a 1 minute professional self intro, speak giving that self intro out loud

tasks.title: Day 115 Asking colleague for help
tasks.description: Listen to someone asking a colleague for help, read a short workplace request email example, write a request for help from a coworker, speak role playing asking a coworker for help

tasks.title: Day 116 Giving a status update
tasks.description: Listen to someone giving a status update, read a short project status report text, write a status update on an imaginary project, speak giving that update out loud

tasks.title: Day 117 Explaining own email verbally
tasks.description: Listen to a workplace email read aloud, read one of your own recent real messages, rewrite it more clearly if needed, speak reading it aloud then explaining it verbally in your own words

tasks.title: Day 118 Coffee break chat
tasks.description: Listen to a coffee break chat, read a short casual workplace chat example, write 3 casual chit chat lines for a break, speak practicing that chit chat out loud

tasks.title: Day 119 Review typical workday
tasks.description: Read your week 17 writing, write on my typical workday, speak free talking and narrating your workday for 3 minutes

tasks.title: Day 120 Opening a meeting
tasks.description: Listen to a meeting opening clip, read a short meeting agenda text, write your own meeting opening lines, speak practicing opening a meeting out loud

tasks.title: Day 121 Meeting status update
tasks.description: Listen to someone giving an update in a meeting, read a short meeting notes example, write your own project update script, speak giving that update out loud

tasks.title: Day 122 Disagreeing professionally
tasks.description: Listen to someone disagreeing professionally, read a short article on professional disagreement phrases, write 2 respectful disagreement phrases, speak practicing disagreeing respectfully in a meeting context

tasks.title: Day 123 Asking clarifying questions
tasks.description: Listen to someone asking clarifying questions, read a short FAQ or Q and A meeting example, write 3 ways to ask for clarification, speak practicing all 3 out loud

tasks.title: Day 124 Meeting closing action items
tasks.description: Listen to a meeting closing or action items clip, read a short meeting minutes example, write a summary of action items, speak practicing summarizing action items out loud

tasks.title: Day 125 Presenting problem and solution
tasks.description: Listen to someone presenting a problem and solution, read a short problem or solution memo text, write a work problem and your proposed solution, speak presenting that problem and solution out loud

tasks.title: Day 126 Review running a meeting
tasks.description: Read your week 18 writing, write on if I ran today's meeting, speak free talking and running that meeting out loud

tasks.title: Day 127 Pitching an idea
tasks.description: Listen to a short TED style pitch, read a short pitch or summary text, write a 2 minute pitch for your own idea, speak pitching that idea out loud

tasks.title: Day 128 Answering tough questions
tasks.description: Listen to someone answering tough questions after a pitch, read a short Q and A after presentation example, write answers to 2 imaginary tough questions, speak practicing answering them out loud

tasks.title: Day 129 Persuading with opinion
tasks.description: Listen to a persuasive speech clip, read a short persuasive essay excerpt, write a persuasive paragraph on your opinion, speak persuading an imaginary person out loud

tasks.title: Day 130 Supporting opinion with example
tasks.description: Listen to someone using data and examples to argue a point, read a short article with statistics or examples, write one real example supporting your opinion, speak supporting your opinion with that example

tasks.title: Day 131 Negotiating deadline or price
tasks.description: Listen to a negotiation clip, read a short negotiation tips article, write a negotiation script for a deadline or price, speak role playing negotiating that deadline or price

tasks.title: Day 132 Explaining complex topic simply
tasks.description: Listen to someone summarizing complex info simply, read a short technical or complex article from your field, write a simple explanation of that complex topic, speak explaining it simply out loud

tasks.title: Day 133 Review pitching career goal
tasks.description: Read your week 19 writing, write a my career or business goal pitch, speak free talking and pitching that goal in 2 minutes

tasks.title: Day 134 Interview tell me about yourself
tasks.description: Listen to a job interview tell me about yourself clip, read a short sample interview answer, write your own professional answer, speak answering that question professionally out loud

tasks.title: Day 135 Interview strengths weaknesses
tasks.description: Listen to a strengths and weaknesses interview clip, read a short article on answering this question well, write your honest strengths and weaknesses answer, speak answering out loud honestly and clearly

tasks.title: Day 136 Interview why this role
tasks.description: Listen to a why this company or role clip, read a short company or job description text, write your answer for a real or imagined job, speak answering that question out loud

tasks.title: Day 137 Interview behavioral question
tasks.description: Listen to a behavioral interview question clip, read a short STAR method example, write your answer using a real story, speak answering with that real story out loud

tasks.title: Day 138 Questions to ask interviewer
tasks.description: Listen to an interview asking the interviewer questions clip, read a short good questions to ask article, write 3 questions to ask an interviewer, speak practicing asking those questions out loud

tasks.title: Day 139 Salary negotiation
tasks.description: Listen to a salary negotiation clip, read a short salary negotiation tips article, write your salary expectations script, speak practicing discussing salary expectations out loud

tasks.title: Day 140 Month 5 mock interview review
tasks.description: Read all your month 5 writing, write notes for a full mock interview with 3 questions and answers, speak free talking for 5 minutes recording a mock full interview and compare fluency to month 1

tasks.title: Day 141 Giving constructive feedback
tasks.description: Listen to a constructive feedback clip, read a short article on giving good feedback, write feedback for a coworker or friend, speak practicing giving that feedback out loud

tasks.title: Day 142 Receiving criticism gracefully
tasks.description: Listen to receiving criticism gracefully, read a short article on handling criticism, write a calm response to criticism, speak practicing responding to criticism calmly

tasks.title: Day 143 Setting a boundary
tasks.description: Listen to a setting a boundary conversation, read a short article on boundary setting language, write a polite but firm no, speak practicing saying no politely but firmly

tasks.title: Day 144 Resolving a conflict
tasks.description: Listen to resolving a conflict clip, read a short conflict resolution article, write a resolution script for a disagreement with a friend, speak role playing resolving that disagreement

tasks.title: Day 145 Delivering bad news
tasks.description: Listen to delivering bad news, read a short article on delivering bad news kindly, write how you would tell someone disappointing news, speak practicing telling that news kindly

tasks.title: Day 146 Standing up for yourself
tasks.description: Listen to a standing up for yourself clip, read a short assertiveness article, write an assertive disagreement statement, speak practicing expressing that disagreement assertively

tasks.title: Day 147 Review hard conversation
tasks.description: Read your week 21 writing, write on a hard conversation I have had or need to have, speak free talking about that conversation for 3 minutes

tasks.title: Day 148 Debate argue one side
tasks.description: Listen to a debate clip on any topic, read a short article arguing one side, write 3 points supporting that side, speak arguing that side for 2 minutes

tasks.title: Day 149 Debate argue other side
tasks.description: Listen to the same debate for the other side, read a short article arguing the opposite side, write 3 points supporting the opposite side, speak arguing the opposite side for 2 minutes

tasks.title: Day 150 Changing your mind gracefully
tasks.description: Listen to someone changing their mind mid conversation, read a short article on changing your opinion gracefully, write I used to think X but now I think Y about a real topic, speak practicing saying that naturally

tasks.title: Day 151 Panel discussion response
tasks.description: Listen to a panel discussion clip, read a short article on the panel topic, write your response as if you were a panel member, speak responding as a panel member out loud

tasks.title: Day 152 Defending opinion under challenge
tasks.description: Listen to someone handling a heckler or challenge, read a short article on defending your opinion under pressure, write a calm rebuttal to a challenge, speak practicing defending your opinion when challenged

tasks.title: Day 153 News headline take
tasks.description: Listen to a news debate segment, read today's news headline, write your take on that headline, speak giving your take out loud

tasks.title: Day 154 Review debate both sides
tasks.description: Read your week 22 writing, write both sides of something you believe, speak free talking and debating yourself arguing both sides

tasks.title: Day 155 Random topic talk
tasks.description: Listen to a random topic generator video or podcast, read a short article on a random topic, write 3 quick points on that topic, speak talking for 2 minutes on that random topic

tasks.title: Day 156 Improv quick answers
tasks.description: Listen to an improv conversation clip, read a short list of random questions, write quick notes rather than full answers on 3 random questions, speak responding immediately with no prep to those 3 questions

tasks.title: Day 157 Unexpected interview questions
tasks.description: Listen to an interview with unexpected questions, read a short unusual interview questions article, write 3 unexpected questions for yourself, speak answering those 3 unprepared questions out loud

tasks.title: Day 158 60 second story under pressure
tasks.description: Listen to a storytelling under time pressure clip, read a short flash fiction or short story, write a 3 sentence story outline, speak telling a 60 second story with no planning beyond the outline

tasks.title: Day 159 Rapid fire Q and A
